missions.name: 1 · First Landing
missions.description: The Remnant comes ashore. Morren holds both towns. Take them or stay in the surf.

missions.name: 2 · Brothers at War
missions.description: The 7th Corps broke ranks at the river. Colonel Vos still wears Remnant colors. Cross and finish it.

missions.name: 3 · The Mountain Passes
missions.description: Tal’s Highland Host has both gates. Force them or freeze in the approaches.

missions.name: 4 · Isle Campaign
missions.description: Venn’s water. Three isles, her gunboats between them.

missions.name: 5 · Two-Front Gambit
missions.description: Morren on one border, Tal on the other. You are the hinge.

missions.name: 6 · The Greywater Crossing
missions.description: Morren dug the river. Three bridges. He will make you pay for each.

missions.name: 7 · Winter Citadel
missions.description: Tal’s last ring in the high country. Rich garrison. No easy road in.

missions.name: 8 · The Shattered Realm
missions.description: The Concord commands have turned on each other — and on you. You start smallest.

missions.name: 9 · Ironshore
missions.description: Venn’s fortress coast. Land under her guns and break the mainland.

missions.name: 10 · World at War
missions.description: Morren, Venn, and Tal on one map. The Remnant is outnumbered. Finish the war.
